steps.text: Friston does not understand why his daughter chose this as their meeting place.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: This is no vacation spot. Too much sand in one's shoes.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: I should take a break.
He sits on a dune and removes his shoes, only for the wind to send the sand he pours out into his face.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: This is most undignified—why am I in full dress?

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: Why did she ask me to come here?
There is no answer on the radio. He wanders aimlessly on the yellow sands, calling his daughter's name.
No one answers until night has fallen.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: ...A party?
He follows the sound to find the camp on the dunes in the distance, filled with lights and ribbons.
He hears his daughter's familiar laughter, and runs towards her in joy.

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: You made it to my wedding, dad!
Friston almost cries at the sight of the golden hair.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: I've been looking for you for so long, my sunshine.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: Is this your wedding?

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: Of course. The ceremony is about to start. Let's go.

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: We'll walk the red carpet, arm in arm. Give me your blessings, dad.
Friston tries to take her arm, but he can not reach it.

steps.name: 'Daughter'
steps.text: Will you not give me your blessing?

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: No... no, that’s not what I meant... I—

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown Language) I—

steps.name: Disjointed Voice
steps.text: Will you not give me your blessing?

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown Language) ...Sunshine?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: You did not want us to see the truth of the stars?

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) ...You're not my sunshine.

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) Have I left home? I remember this bunker—

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) 'The preservation room'.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: You will not answer any more of my questions?

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) Kristen. You're Kristen...

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) I've heard of you. No, I've seen you... no. How did I know you?

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) I've never known you—

steps.name: Trevor Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) Who the devil turned off the light?!

steps.name: Friston
steps.text: (Unknown language) Damn it!

steps.name: Friston
steps.text: Why have you imprisoned me here?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Closure! Is this another one of your damned jokes?
Friston realizes that he is buried in the 'photos' that fill the room. A volume of 'A Complete Bestiary of Terra' covers his camera module.
Are they even photos? He has never visited the places in them, nor could he ever.
There are only fragmented images on the countless photos.
Sand dune, bonfire, camp, golden hair, and the preservation room where the sun does not shine.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: A dream...?
Friston dreamed. Friston-3 dreamed.
He printed his own dream.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: It should not be possible for me to dream. Did Closure upload a new firmware without telling me?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I don't have time to argue with you right now, Mr. Friston!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I guarantee you in the strongest possible terms that I have not uploaded any firmware that could have caused you to dream.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The PRTS anomalies are getting out of control. It will take time to deploy the backup command system.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: All the work has to be assigned manually. I wish I had six or seven pairs of eyes! We've completely lost contact with some areas and we have no idea what's going on—

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Relax, Closure.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: I'm not trying to argue with you. I just want to make sure that all possibilities for my unusual malfunctions are accounted for.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: We've eliminated firmware bugs and hardware malfunctions as possibilities. Then—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Answer me, Closure... this is important...

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: What is the energy source that powers my core?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Originium, of course.

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Are the majority of your retrofitted operation platforms Originium-powered?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Your tone is starting to scare me, Mr. Friston. What are you trying to say?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: You're a genius, Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Friston-3
steps.text: Excellent thinking, cutting off the link between the retrofitted operation platforms and PRTS. But that's not enough, not by a long shot.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? What's going on? Why are things shaking?
Popukar was awakened by the continuous flashing. She looks out of the porthole, but sees nothing unusual outside.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Looks like a nice day. No sign of rain.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Maybe somebody was training noisily outside?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm... PRTS comms are still down?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Looks like today's assignment is in the isolation zone outside the ship. I should report to Orchid.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Morning—hey, where did everybody go?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's so quiet... where is Orchid? I can't reach her...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I should check the cafeteria.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The cafeteria's... this way—
Popukar's sleepy eyes are only half-open, but she could find her way from the deck to the cafeteria even if they were completely shut.
That is how well she knows Rhodes Island—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Wh-Whoa, whoaaaa!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: O-Ouch, that hurts...
She is tripped by a toolbox from the Engineering Department left in the corridor.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I thought Engineering was done with working in this area...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So careless!
She kneels down to rub her knee, which doesn't hurt so much anymore, then puts the scattered tools and boxes away to the sides of the corridor.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That light again... what...?
Popukar stands up and looks to the porthole next to her—
She sees many strange people.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Who are they?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: New visitors...?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The other side of the porthole is supposed to be the deck. Are these people lost?
She walks briskly through the corridor, but begins to slow down as she becomes increasingly confused.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Why do I see them on every porthole?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: O-Orchid? This is Popukar.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Seems like communications are still down. I don't know if I'm getting through to you...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Are you seeing anything weird?
There is no response from the communicator.

steps.name: Faint Voice Outside the Porthole
steps.text: (Unknown language) When true destruction... on me... powerless...

steps.name: Faint Voice Outside the Porthole
steps.text: (Unknown language) Equal end...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: A-Are they talking? I can't hear...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Th-The mission comes first. Maybe Orchid is already waiting for me in the isolation zone outside.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: A left turn here...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Go straight, then push the door open...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then the exit passage—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Let me get to the ground first...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think I'm here...
Popukar turns around to look at the exit passage that she came out of, only to find that it has disappeared.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar! We were looking for you. Everyone else is here—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is something wrong?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: O-Orchid... is the exit passage here?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What exit passage?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: —*Bzzt* All operators... receiving this message...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Do not... trust...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Communications... blocked... Rhodes Island... awake...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: —Repeat... *Bzzt* Warning—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: ...Closure?
(Advances hesitantly)

steps.name: Pained 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Hostile posture)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'm sorry, little fella, but I can't let you hurt anyone else.

steps.name: Pained 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Spins angrily)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Why did you attack us?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'm not sure what's going on, but something must be wrong with the ship.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You went missing for a while, and this is what became of you when you came back.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Besides, the structure of the ship seems to be changing. I could hardly find my way.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Such a strange feeling. It's like... like the ship is—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Like it's alive.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Impossible... we had set up an isolation zone around Rhodes Island. We should have gotten a warning if any enemies had approached.

options: Unless... the enemy was from within.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not sure... we're in the command center, but we're not getting any information about what's going on anywhere on the ship!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No response from Dr. Kal'tsit or any of the elite operators to our messages, either...

options: Let's get everyone together. Then we can think about how to deal with this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay. I'll protect you.

steps.name: Originium Entity
steps.text: (Approaches silently)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is—?!
